chisel.line: Now I ain't the sharpest chisel
chisel.lineNext: That your hands have ever held
stanza: Now I ain't the sharpest chisel
That your hands have ever held
But darlin' I could love you well
'Til the roll is called on high
I've seen my share of trouble
And I've held my weight in shame
But I'm baptized in your name
Lovely Lady May

chisel.linePrev: Don't impress me, what can I offer?
chisel.line: Because I am a chisel in Your hand
chisel.lineNext: Screaming at marble from a microphone stand
stanza: 'Cause great men of science and literature
Don't impress me, what can I offer?
Because I am a chisel in Your hand
Screaming at marble from a microphone stand

drizzle.linePrev: Father Lucifer you never looked so sane
drizzle.line: You always did prefer the drizzle to the rain
drizzle.lineNext: Tell me that you're still in love with that milkmaid
stanza: Father Lucifer you never looked so sane
You always did prefer the drizzle to the rain
Tell me that you're still in love with that milkmaid
How the Lizzies, how's your Jesus Christ been hanging?

drizzle.line: Drums are drizzling on a grain of sand
drizzle.lineNext: Fading rhythms of a fading land
stanza: Drums are drizzling on a grain of sand
Fading rhythms of a fading land
Prove your courage in the proud parade
Trust your leaders where mistakes are almost never made
And they're afraid that I'm afraid

drizzle.linePrev: Coming home at the end of the working day
drizzle.line: I was riding alone through the drizzling rain on a deserted stretch of a county…
drizzle.lineNext: When I came upon a wreck on the highway
stanza: Last night, I was out driving
Coming home at the end of the working day
I was riding alone through the drizzling rain on a deserted stretch of a county…
When I came upon a wreck on the highway

drizzle.line: I hear the drizzle of the rain
stanza: I hear the drizzle of the rain
Like a memory it falls
Soft and warm continuing
Tapping on my roof and walls

sizzle.linePrev: And when the street lights sputter out
sizzle.line: They make this awful sizzling sound
sizzle.lineNext: I cast my gaze toward the pavement
stanza: When the sun goes down, the armies of the voiceless
Several hundred-thousand strong
Come out without their bandages
Their voices raised in song
And when the street lights sputter out
They make this awful sizzling sound
I cast my gaze toward the pavement
Too many blood stains on the ground
